Built for global job seekers. For recruiters: screen candidates faster with AI interviews and instant scored reports.

No account required, no personal data collection, and no invasive tracking. Vigia adds a protective layer to your smartphone, warning you when something doesn’t look right, before a suspicious interaction turns into a costly mistake.

posts.description: Kotoba Dojo is a gamified training ground for precise wording. You see a reference image → describe it in your own words → an AI regenerates the image from your description → you get scored on how close it got. Rank up from white belt to black belt. 22 languages. Credit system. Sign in with Apple/Google, Stripe, GDPR account deletion. Built by a solo founder with zero engineering background, using only AI coding agents. 16 days, ~40 hours of directed work, from blank to production.

posts.name: CareerGini

Instead of simply showing you more things to buy, Luvloot helps you make better use of what you already own, avoid purchases that never leave your wardrobe, and shop with more confidence.
